description: Time-value-of-money solver (TVM) — Financial-calculator / Excel TVM solver: give any four of n (periods), rate (annual %), pv, pmt, fv and solve= the fifth (n|rate|pv|pmt|fv). Loan payments, payoff time, implied interest rate, savings goals, annuity present value, balloon payments. Optional periods_per_year (default 12; 1, 4, 52...), type=end|begin (annuity due). Excel sign convention: cash received positive, cash paid negative. Returns the solved value, effective annual rate, years, total in/out, interest cost or earned, and the matching Excel formula. Offline, instant. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_tvm
